name: GOV monad-protocols: PeerSet (LayerZero V2 OApp / OFT)
description: LayerZero V2 OApp / OFT: PeerSet(uint32,bytes32) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity high. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
